tools.viewer: OpenROAD web viewer (built without Qt GUI: '-GUI' in feature list) rendered by Chromium via Playwright

capture.method: openroad -no_init -web -web_no_browser -web_bind 0.0.0.0 -web_port <port> capture_stage.tcl; CAPTURE_DB and CAPTURE_SDC supplied via environment; browser screenshot of the #pane-main layout element with viewer side panels and status banner hidden by CSS
capture.note: The installed OpenROAD has no Qt GUI (-GUI), so save_image was unavailable. The web viewer rendered static layout tiles from the saved database. Its WebSocket upgrade failed, producing a transient 'disconnected' banner which was hidden for the capture; layout tiles were already rendered from the loaded ODB. No source database was modified; post-capture hashes match pre-capture hashes.

presentation.purpose: Display-only derivatives of the immutable raw captures; no geometry, colour or layer data was altered.
presentation.method: 1:1 lossless crop, nearest-neighbour interpolation, PNG output via System.Drawing
presentation.note: Raw full-view images remain under original/ with the original hashes unchanged. Scale-bar labels differ in the routing image (100 um) from the other four (20 um) although the die footprint is identical in pixels; this is a viewer artefact and no physical distance is inferred from these bars in captions.

presentation_detail.method: OpenROAD save_image -web rendered directly from each saved ODB at stage-specific micron areas (1200 px width), composited onto opaque black. No crop-only upscaling, no geometry or layer-colour changes.
presentation_detail.render_command_form: read_db <stage>.odb; save_image -web -area {x0 y0 x1 y1} -width 1200 -display_option {...} <out>.png; exit

omitted.cts: A clock-only detail render was produced from 4_cts.odb with net_clock/routing visibility enabled, but no distinct clock topology is visible; publishing a near-duplicate of placement would overstate CTS evidence. Full-die CTS view retained.
omitted.final: Final detail is visually redundant with routing detail (the ODB differs only subtly after routing); full-die final view retained.

run.verified_by: independent verification record baseline_1ns_verify.json: overall PASS, DRT final 0

provenance_notes: No SattvaRoute source commit SHA was recorded in the run evidence; do not infer one.
